title: Casa Maya
subtitle: The Cenote Grove
description:
An Elemental Retreat on an Expansive Double Lot
Nestled upon a rare double-sized lot within the quietest enclave of Puerto Aventuras, this 3-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom residence is a tribute to the Riviera Maya’s natural soul. Designed for those who seek a profound connection with the landscape, the home breathes through wide-open spaces and luminous interiors, offering an atmosphere of unhurried elegance and absolute privacy.

A Private Portal to the Ancestral
The crown jewel of this estate is a private, ancient cenote tucked within the lush grounds, a sacred water feature that creates a living, breathing connection to the earth’s history. Surrounding this natural wonder, the outdoor living areas feature a pristine saltwater pool and a deep-shaded patio, crafted for long afternoons of quiet reflection or intimate gatherings under the jungle canopy.

Intelligent Autonomy
True luxury is self-sufficiency. This residence is engineered for zero-friction living, powered by a high-efficiency 24-panel solar system and a professional-grade reverse osmosis water filtration system. Whether used as a primary residence or a high-tier vacation retreat, the home is delivered fully furnished and turnkey, ensuring a seamless transition into a lifestyle of tropical serenity.
